load_model_from_asset: load a pretrained model from an asset card or model name string using the unified load_model function
create_new_model_from_config: create a new model instance with random weights from a ModelConfig using ModelHub.create_new_model
load_custom_model_from_checkpoint: load a model from a custom checkpoint file path with a provided config using ModelHub.load_custom_model
iterate_model_cards: iterate over all available asset cards for a model family using ModelHub.iter_cards
get_model_arch_config: get the configuration object for a specific model architecture name using ModelHub.get_arch_config
